This deep value proposition is further reinforced by the data provider key-ratios, which record an even more attractive price-to-book ratio of 0.55x compared to the sector benchmark of 1.37x [E6]. The valuation disconnect is starkly visible when examining the price-to-earnings ratio of 0x, sitting radically below the broader sector benchmark of 20.07x [E5]. With a market capitalisation of ₹ 80.0 Cr [E2] and the stock currently residing at a depressed 11% of the way up its 52-week range [E4], the market has heavily overcorrected. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor sales growth of -18.7% over the past five years [E49] alongside negative returns on equity and assets [E7, E8]. Despite these operational headwinds, the sheer asset backing at these discounted multiples offers a compelling margin of safety for patient capital.
